title: Contrix Standard Event Payloads
description: Common payload contracts for registered cx.* Event.kind values. Event validators MUST combine these payload classes with artifacts/registry/event-kind-registry.json.

board_place_id.description: A Place with kind=board. Pattern matches any cx:place:; kind invariant enforced by reducer/profile.

track.description: Active track name on the target Flow. Mirrors message.schema.json#/properties/track. v1 reducers only recognise 'discussion' for Message timeline; profiles MAY declare additional track names but v1 interop SHOULD use 'discussion'.

patch_path.description: Contrix field patch path. Segments are snake_case identifiers, optional stable-key selectors (such as profile-declared named-collection arrays of the form `<field>[<key>=<value>]`), or backtick-quoted literals; numeric array indexes are not part of cx.patch.v1. v1 standard schemas no longer use stable-key selectors — Flow tracks is now a map keyed by track name, so paths like `tracks.discussion.profile` are plain object segments.

patch_value.description: A plain value is shorthand for {"$op":"set","value":...}. Objects containing $op MUST be patch_operation objects.

object_snapshot.description: Embedded object snapshot inside an Event payload. Object kind is derived from the typed-id prefix on `id`; there is no separate `type` field.

space_create_payload.description: Create payload uses the full Space object schema for wire validation. Semantic validation MUST require payload.object.created_by_principal to match the top-level actor_id and payload.object.created_at to match the top-level created_at before acceptance.

flow_create_payload.description: Create payload uses the full Flow object schema for wire validation. Semantic validation MUST require payload.object.created_by to match the top-level actor_id and payload.object.created_at to match the top-level created_at before acceptance.

morph_create_payload.description: Create payload uses the full Morph object schema for wire validation. Semantic validation MUST require payload.object.created_by to match the top-level actor_id and payload.object.created_at to match the top-level created_at before acceptance.

actor_profile_create_payload.description: Initial actor profile payload. In Move/Anchor/Lattice state, the profile cell subject is payload.object.id.

track.description: Active track of the target Flow. Optional on revise/redact: when omitted, reducers MUST resolve from the existing message identified by message_id / target_ref / revision_of. When present, MUST equal that resolved track.
Active track of the redacted message's parent Flow. Optional: when omitted, reducers MUST resolve from the existing message. When present, MUST equal that resolved track.

reaction_payload.description: Reducer input for cx.reaction.add and cx.reaction.remove. OR-Set membership is keyed on (actor_id, target_ref, key); a remove tombstones every prior add from the same actor with the same key in the causal past. See zh/crypto-media/encryption-and-audit.md §2.9 for the plaintext-vs-encrypted policy.

key.description: Reaction key. Plaintext spaces SHOULD use a single Unicode emoji cluster or registered short tag. End-to-end-encrypted spaces with `aad_visibility != opaque_id` SHOULD carry a deterministic routing hash here (`sha256("cx-reaction-key-v1" || mls_group_id || epoch || canonical_emoji)`) so that OR-Set dedup, rate-limit and reducer convergence keep working without revealing the chosen emoji; the canonical emoji travels in `encrypted_payload`.

annotation.description: Optional free-form annotation (e.g. issue triage label). MUST be omitted when `encrypted_payload` is present; in E2EE spaces the annotation MUST instead be carried inside `encrypted_payload`.

encrypted_payload.description: Encrypted carrier for the canonical reaction key and any annotation in E2EE spaces. When present, plaintext `key` (if any) MUST be a routing hash and `annotation` MUST be omitted; OR-Set convergence runs after client-side decryption.

progress_basis_points.description: Progress in basis points (0..10000 = 0%..100%). v1 wire forbids non-integer numbers; producers MUST use integer scaled forms.

agent_task_create_payload.description: Payload for cx.agent_task.create. Carries the new agent_task object + 3 initial FSM cell values. NOTE: reservation_ttl_seconds is NOT here; reservation TTL lives on the dedicated cx.agent_workspace.reservation.set event (see agent_workspace_reservation_set_payload).

agent_task_transition_payload.description: Payload for cx.agent_task.{execution,transparency,source_authority}.transition. NOTE: ttl_evidence is NOT here; orphan cleanup lives on the dedicated cx.agent_workspace.reservation.cleanup event (see agent_workspace_reservation_cleanup_payload).

agent_workspace_reservation_cell_namespa.description: Discriminator selecting which reservation cell namespace this Move targets. Spec: agent-workspace-profile.md §6.1.

agent_workspace_reservation_set_payload.description: Payload for cx.agent_workspace.reservation.set. Carries the reservation Move's cell namespace, subject (source_*_id), pre-allocated mirror_*_id (effect value), and TTL hint. The actual cas-register precondition (head_eq:'__unset__') and effect are encoded in the Move envelope; this payload is reducer-input metadata + audit trail.

cell_namespace_subject.description: Source object ID this reservation pertains to (cx:space:... when namespace=mirror_space_by_source; cx:flow:... when namespace=mirror_flow_by_source).

reservation_id.description: Pre-allocated mirror_*_id (cx:space:<uuidv7> or cx:flow:<uuidv7>) the reservation claims.

reservation_ttl_seconds.description: Reservation TTL hint (seconds). Default 600. After this window without a follow-up create event, sync node housekeeping MAY emit a cx.agent_workspace.reservation.cleanup. See agent-workspace-profile.md §6.4.

agent_workspace_reservation_recover_payl.description: Payload for cx.agent_workspace.reservation.recover. Recovery Move resolves cell ⊥ per event-auth-state-resolution.md §8: head_in [conflict_heads] + state_witness + inclusion_proof refs + recovery_capability ref. Effect value MUST be the lex-min of conflict_heads.

conflict_heads.description: Pre-conflict candidate heads observed in the ⊥ diagnostic. The recovery Move's predicate MUST be head_in[<this list>].

winner.description: Lex-min winner selected from conflict_heads. Reducer MUST verify the effect value matches lex-min(conflict_heads) before accepting.

agent_workspace_reservation_cleanup_payl.description: Payload for cx.agent_workspace.reservation.cleanup. Cleanup Move resets a stale reservation cell to '__unset__' after the TTL window has elapsed. ttl_evidence MUST be Anchor-based (NOT self-reported wall-clock). Reducer verifies current_anchor_index >= reservation_anchor_index + ttl_anchor_distance.

stale_reservation_id.description: Cell head value the cleanup Move expects (head_eq predicate). The Move's effect resets to '__unset__'.

consent_grant_payload.description: Holder-private consent grant. The actor (consenter) is the holder; payload.peer is the counterparty whose contact is consented to. Wire-equivalent to a Move whose effect is add(tag,value) on the cell cx:cell:cx.component.consent.grant.v1:<consent_id> (or-set lattice); cx.consent.revoke writes a remove on the same cell. Lives in the holder's principal control Space (or holder-private actor stream); MUST NOT be written to a shared collaboration Space.

consent_id.description: Stable identifier; used as the cell_subject of the consent cell. cx.consent.revoke MUST reference the same consent_id.

peer.description: Counterparty DID (or pairwise DID) that this consent applies to.

scope.description: What kind of contact is consented to. 'invite' = peer may send Space / Flow invites; 'direct_message' = peer may initiate 1:1 message; 'voice_call' / 'video_call' = peer may initiate WebRTC call; 'presence' = peer may observe presence; 'any' = full consent across all scopes.

constraints.description: Optional consent-specific constraints (rate limits, time-of-day windows, device restrictions). v1 does not standardise constraint types beyond capability constraint vocabulary.

evidence_ref.description: Optional reference to claim disclosure, presentation response, or invite proof that triggered this consent (audit trail).

consent_revoke_payload.description: Revoke a previously granted consent. Wire-equivalent to a Move whose effect is remove(tag) on the consent cell cx:cell:cx.component.consent.grant.v1:<consent_id> (the same cell written by cx.consent.grant).

consent_id.description: MUST equal the consent_id of the cx.consent.grant being revoked.

crypto_device_payload.description: Deprecated compatibility union. Event validators SHOULD use the kind-specific payload defs for security-sensitive device, MLS, and space key events.

board_place_id.description: Board Place that owns the position edge; deduplication key (board_place_id, flow_id) MUST be unique among active edges.

from_place_id.description: Source List Place (optional; reducer infers from current active edge if omitted).

place_id.description: List Place within which the reorder happens.
